svg.text: Psychology optional — the experiment bank feeds the programme bank
paper 1 science core · paper 2 applied arcs · precision marking: never invent a study
PAPER 1 — THE SCIENCE CORE
Methods: experiment · correlation · ethics · WEIRD caution
Brain bases · attention · Gestalt perception
Learning: Pavlov · Skinner · Bandura (observational)
Memory: multistore → Baddeley's working model · mnemonics
Thinking: heuristics (Kahneman) · creativity
Emotion trio: James-Lange · Cannon-Bard · Schachter-Singer
Personality: Big Five vs Freud · attitudes & dissonance
Groups: Asch · Milgram · leadership styles
style: def → model → named experiment → critique (+diagram)
PAPER 2 — APPLIED ARCS
Well-being: Selye stress · Lazarus appraisal · PERMA
Disorders: anxiety · mood · schizophrenia (+diathesis-stress)
Therapies: CBT ladder · behaviour · humanistic · mindfulness
Work-IO: selection · Herzberg at work · culture · ergonomics
Educational: inclusion · giftedness · teacher effectiveness
Community: deinstitutionalisation · NMHS districts
Frontier: sports (Khelo India) · deradicalisation · env. nudges
style: theory → Indian programme (NMHS · Manodarpan · EAP) → datum
TWELVE-WEEK FIRST PASS + THE TWO BANKS
wk 1-3 foundations · wk 4-5 learning-memory-thinking · wk 6-7 emotion-personality-intelligence · wk 8 social · wk 9-10 well-being+disorders · wk 11 work-education-community · wk 12 PYQ map
experiment bank ×20 (design+finding, 2 lines each) · programme bank: NMHS · Manodarpan · EAPs · UJALA/SB-norms
